summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting the pricing of US$1.0 billion senior notes offering in two tranches: US$500 million of 4.850% notes due 2031 and US$500 million of 5.350% notes due 2036. The offering will close May 29, 2026, with proceeds to repay US$500 million of 4.000% notes maturing December 2026, reduce short-term credit facilities, and for general corporate purposes. Joint book-runners are CIBC, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Scotia. Notes are unsecured senior debt. This is a routine debt refinancing. No special situation is present.
